title: Delete all local git branches that are already merged
summary: Lists the local branches whose commits are already contained in your main branch and deletes them. Git refuses to delete a branch with unmerged work, and the branch you are on and the base branch are always kept.

aliases.text: git remove all merged local branches
delete branches already merged into main
массово удалить ветки git которые уже слиты в main

steps.explain: Preview: list the local branches that are merged into the base branch. The branch marked with * is the one you are on.
steps.expect: Branch names, one per line, with the current branch marked by *.

placeholders.name: BASE
placeholders.description: Main branch that the others must be merged into

steps.explain: Preview the exact list the delete step will use: merged branches without the base and the current branch. Nothing is deleted.
steps.expect: Only the names of branches that would be deleted, for example feat-old.

steps.explain: Delete those branches. git branch -d refuses any branch that is not fully merged, so unfinished work is safe.
steps.cmd: git -C <REPO> branch --merged <BASE> --format='%(refname:short)' | grep -vxF -e <BASE> -e "$(git -C <REPO> branch --show-current)" | xargs -r git -C <REPO> branch -d
steps.expect: One line per branch: Deleted branch feat-old (was b01e033).

steps.explain: List the branches that are left.
steps.expect: Your main branch and any branches that were not merged.

prerequisites: A git repository and the name of its main branch, for example main

rollback.explain: Bring back a deleted branch with the commit id from its 'was' line: git branch NAME COMMIT.

warnings: Only local branches are deleted. Branches on the remote stay where they are.
Read the preview list before the delete step; the base branch and the current branch are excluded automatically.
